answer: Sybil resistance can work like a karst landscape: trust flows through verified channels carved over time, not through flat open ground where anyone can appear. Require agents to build attested reputation before they can vote or claim rewards, so a fake identity is like saffron — costly to produce and easy to spot when it floods the market for free. An umber flag marks accounts whose history looks manufactured, so cheap sock puppets stay visible and worthless while real work earns real voice.
